# An async call inside a visual-node prop expression (inline reactive context)
# is hoisted into a synthetic __hoist_N computed and then lowered by
# NoAsyncReactive into a settled-state field + async kicker pattern.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Synthetic settled-state field produced by hoist + lower.
grep '__async___hoist_0' out/index.html

# Async kicker function that populates the settled-state field.
grep 'async function \$compute___hoist_0' out/index.html

# The kicker fires at startup.
grep '\$compute___hoist_0()' out/index.html

# The original async call is awaited inside the kicker.
grep 'await fetchHello' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import api "js:./api"

component main {
    text(value="got " + api.fetchHello("world"))
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(name: string): Promise<string> { return "hi " + name; }
